coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, pygidium +Y, dorsal +Z. Side view must expose under-pleural gill comb above walking limbs.

concept.reason: Actual complete ventral fossil plus scaled same-species reconstruction and modern appendage study sufficient.

extra_views.reason: Repeated under-pleural gill combs overlap in side and perspective silhouettes. A single canonical underside view resolves upper filament-bearing shafts versus lower walking branches and their reconstructed common bases.

scope: Complete living trilobite with rounded cephalon, fourteen articulated thoracic segments, small pygidium, paired antennae and visible repeated walking-leg/gill branches. Same-species synthesis anchored to YPM219 actual ventral fossil photograph, Treatise whole-body diagram and modern T.eatoni limb research.

scientific_limits.en: Body27mm is estimated from the10mm bar on the Treatise reconstruction in Casey/Lieberman Fig7A, NOT a measured size of YPM219 shown separately in Fig7B. Depth, posture and missing limb tips are inferred; pygidial limb count is a simplified reconstruction. Hou2021 Fig4C is a proposed T.eatoni articulation; direct body-wall junction evidence there comes from Olenoides, not proof that the same junction is preserved in Triarthrus. Living color unknown; pyrite gold is mineralization.
scientific_limits.zh: 体长27毫米按Casey/Lieberman图7A中Treatise复原图的10毫米尺估计，不是右侧图7B标本YPM219的实测。体厚姿态与缺失足端为推断，尾板足数为简化复原。Hou2021图4C是同种附肢连接假说，体壁连接直接实证来自Olenoides，不冒称Triarthrus已保存。活体颜色未知，金色为黄铁矿矿化。

scale.uncertainty: About15percent planar reconstruction estimate. Fig7A10mmbar approx157px and bodyapprox427px at rendered1041pxpage; do not apply this bar to separate photo7B.

anatomy: Broad rounded cephalon with raised central glabella and paired modest lateral eyes; narrow axial lobe continues along segmented trunk. Do not use giant genal spines.
Fourteen discrete thoracic tergites, repeated axial rings and lateral pleurae, followed by a small rounded pygidium. Preserve articulation gaps rather than one smooth shell.

One pair of forward slender segmented antennae. Three pairs of post-antennal cephalic biramous appendages, fourteen thoracic pairs, and four progressively tiny pygidial pairs as schematic completion. Pygidial count is not claimed measured in YPM219.
Each repeated biramous limb has a lower jointed walking branch and an upper shaft carrying a comb of short gill filaments. Gills stay under pleurae above walking legs, not giant external fins.
Walking branches extend modestly beyond shell margins for readable side silhouette; add terminal tapered claws and simplify proximal feeding spines. No swimming paddle substitution.
Use restrained matte earthy cuticle. Actual photographed gold is pyrite and must not be described as living coloration. Gill shade may be slightly lighter for readability, not a fossil color claim.
restoration_boundaries: YPM219 is actual photo7B from Yale collection credited to Bruce Lieberman; source spells Triarthus but intended taxon is Triarthrus eatoni. Photo itself has no scale.
Treatise diagram7A supplies whole dorsal/ventral arrangement,14thoracicsegments and10mmbar; not claimed same specimen219 or one pristine individual.
Hou,Hughes,Hopkins2021 real T.eatoni micrographs support filament-bearing upper branch; Fig4C gives explicit proposed same-species structure. Do not copy Fig4B Olenoides body shape.
Filament cross-section and blood channels are microscopic scientific findings, not colored visible tubes on outer model. Simplify to comb-like blades.
Three-dimensional depth, restored symmetry and appendage posture interpretive. No egg cluster, sex-specific structures or inferred reproductive claim added.
quality_gates: Both walking and gill branches must be visible in side/perspective views, not just a dorsal shell.
Antennae distinct from walking limbs; no exterior back-mounted gill fins.
Fixed4views first; if gill relation cannot be inspected, one purposeful underside QA view only, not routine extra images.
Scale provenance separated fromYPM219; proposed versus directly observed limb junction and unknown living color remain explicit.
